question: ‘Margomkali’, a ritual folk art form, is from the state of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__
 
• **Margomkali** is a ritual folk art of the **Syrian Christians of the Kottayam and Thrissur districts.**
 
• A dozen dancers sing and dance around a lighted wick lamp (Nilavilakku), clad in the simple traditional white dhoti and sporting a peacock feather on the turban to add a touch of colour.

 [IMAGE: https://www.keralatourism.org/images/picture/thumb/Margomkali_The_Divine_Steps_2219.jpg]
